errors.text: The proposed refractory NbMoTaWVTi-type alloy and Mo/Re additions do not reconstruct the equimolar CoCrFeNiTi powder system.
The route omits the essential high-energy ball-milling plus short-duration spark-plasma-sintering sequence and its defined processing window.
Gamma/gamma-prime lattice misfit and N-type rafting are imported from precipitation-strengthened superalloys without evidence that they apply to the proposed refractory FCC/BCC alloy.
Invoking gamma-prime precipitates is inconsistent with the requested dual-phase solid-solution constitution and may itself introduce an ordered intermetallic phase.
The cited evidence does not establish that Mo or Re suppresses Laves or Heusler nucleation, stabilizes grains below 50 nm, or creates an FCC/BCC phase mixture in this alloy.
No quantitative phase fraction, density, hardness, yield strength, or compressive-strength prediction corresponding to the target result is provided.
